name: school_interior
description: A cozy Greek school classroom where animal children gather to learn and play.

color_palette: Soft blue (#ADD8E6) for walls to create a calming learning environment
Warm yellow (#FFD700) for accents and furniture to promote energy and focus
Rich green (#228B22) for decorative elements and plants to symbolize growth and knowledge
visual_style.architectural_style: Simple, clean lines with low ceilings typical of traditional Greek village schoolhouses. White-washed walls with exposed wooden beams create an authentic Mediterranean feel. Large windows allow natural light to flood the space.
visual_style.furniture: Low wooden desks and chairs in honey-colored oak are arranged in small groups to encourage collaboration. A teacher's podium sits at the front, decorated with blue and white pottery. Colorful woven rugs in geometric patterns cover stone floors, defining different activity areas.
materials: Whitewashed stucco walls with wooden beam accents
Honey-colored oak furniture with blue and white painted details
Stone floors with colorful woven rugs
